summary: The Hertz Corporation disclosed an October 16, 2026 joint venture arrangement in which JV investors—Cohen Private Ventures and funds affiliated with Certares and/or Knighthead—agreed to buy Class A units of Oro Mobility Holdings LLC from Hertz for about $80.89 million, representing 50% of voting units and roughly 15.86% of common units. Concurrently, Hertz repurchased about $51.1 million principal of its 8.000% Exchangeable Senior Second-Lien PIK Notes due 2029 at roughly $20.86 million, a 60% discount to par, from Certares/Knighthead affiliates; Hertz pre-contributed Oro Business assets plus about $60.03 million cash to Oro. Watch governance rights, related-party optics and residual 2L Notes overhang.
